chinese.title: 9 月 7 日更新：操作体验与问题修复
body_items: 新增“精简特效”选项，可减少装饰粒子和拖尾。
优化野猪林操作提示、祝家庄任务信息和营救后的队伍选择。
修复设置面板显示层级及关闭异常。
修复飞斧目标失效时影响后续命中的问题，并减少部分重复绘制计算。

english.title: September 7 Update: Gameplay Improvements and Fixes
english.summary: Added a reduced effects option, improved mission and control hints, and fixed settings panel and throwing axe issues.
body_items: Added a reduced effects option to decrease decorative particles and trails.
Improved control hints in Wild Boar Forest, mission information in Zhu Family Village, and unit selection after rescues.
Fixed settings panel layering and closing issues.
Fixed throwing axes failing to process later hits when a target became invalid, and reduced some redundant drawing calculations.
